ASSURANCE_DECODED_OBSERVATION_ALL_SUCCES:
!len inst s s'.
    x86_decode s (read RIP s) (len,inst) /\ x86 s s'
    ==> assurance_observed_step s
          (assurance_observation s len inst s') s'
CRYPTO_FIRST_RET_CALL_SHAPE:
!pc (p:int64) q n stackpointer returnaddress.
    crypto_ret_shape (crypto_public_call pc p q n stackpointer returnaddress)
CRYPTO_FIRST_RET_E2_EXISTS:
!pc stackpointer returnaddress p q n m rp xp ordinary s.
   bp_e2_crypto_pre pc stackpointer returnaddress p q n m rp xp ordinary s ==>
   ?t. crypto_first_ret_execution
        (crypto_public_call pc p q n stackpointer returnaddress) s t /\
       read RIP t=returnaddress /\ read RSP t=word_add stackpointer (word 8)
CRYPTO_FIRST_RET_EXECUTION_EQUIVALENT:
!trace (s:x86state) t.
    crypto_first_ret_execution trace s t <=>
    crypto_observed_execution trace s t /\ crypto_ret_shape trace
CRYPTO_FIRST_RET_EXECUTION_EXISTS:
!trace P s. crypto_observed_run trace P s /\ crypto_ret_shape trace ==>
    ?t. crypto_first_ret_execution trace s t /\ P t
CRYPTO_FIRST_RET_FORCE:
!public P (s:x86state) other t.
    crypto_observed_run public P s /\ crypto_ret_shape public /\
    crypto_first_ret_execution other s t
    ==> other=public /\ P t
CRYPTO_FIRST_RET_LOOP_SHAPE:
!n pc (p:int64) q stackpointer returnaddress.
    crypto_ret_shape (crypto_public_loop pc p q n stackpointer returnaddress)
CRYPTO_FIRST_RET_PREFIX:
!prefix suffix:(int64#num#instruction#uarch_event list)list.
    ALL (\obs. ~crypto_observation_is_ret obs) prefix /\ crypto_ret_shape suffix
    ==> crypto_ret_shape (APPEND prefix suffix)
CRYPTO_FIRST_RET_RELATIONAL:
!pc stackpointer returnaddress p q n m1 m2 rp xp ordinary
       (s1:x86state) s2 trace1 trace2 t1 t2.
    bp_e2_crypto_pre pc stackpointer returnaddress p q n m1 rp xp ordinary s1 /\
    bp_e2_crypto_pre pc stackpointer returnaddress p q n m2 rp xp ordinary s2 /\
    crypto_first_ret_execution trace1 s1 t1 /\
    crypto_first_ret_execution trace2 s2 t2
    ==> trace1=crypto_public_call pc p q n stackpointer returnaddress /\
        trace2=crypto_public_call pc p q n stackpointer returnaddress /\
        trace1=trace2 /\
        read RIP t1=returnaddress /\ read RSP t1=word_add stackpointer (word 8) /\
        read RIP t2=returnaddress /\ read RSP t2=word_add stackpointer (word 8)
CRYPTO_FIRST_RET_SHAPE_CHARACTERIZATION:
!trace:(int64#num#instruction#uarch_event list)list.
    crypto_ret_shape trace <=>
    ~(trace=[]) /\ crypto_observation_is_ret (LAST trace) /\
    ALL (\obs. ~crypto_observation_is_ret obs) (BUTLAST trace)
CRYPTO_OBSERVATION_ALL_PAIRS:
!pc stackpointer returnaddress p q n m1 m2 rp xp ordinary
       (s1:x86state) s2 trace1 trace2 t1 t2.
    bp_e2_crypto_pre pc stackpointer returnaddress p q n m1 rp xp ordinary s1 /\
    bp_e2_crypto_pre pc stackpointer returnaddress p q n m2 rp xp ordinary s2 /\
    LENGTH trace1=(if n=0 then 6 else if n=16 then 15 else 7*n+10) /\
    LENGTH trace2=(if n=0 then 6 else if n=16 then 15 else 7*n+10) /\
    crypto_observed_execution trace1 s1 t1 /\
    crypto_observed_execution trace2 s2 t2
    ==> trace1=crypto_public_call pc p q n stackpointer returnaddress /\
        trace2=crypto_public_call pc p q n stackpointer returnaddress /\
        trace1=trace2
CRYPTO_OBSERVATION_BODY7:
!pc p q count m (s:x86state).
    0<count /\ count<2 EXP 64 /\
    bytes_loaded s (word pc) crypto_memcmp_mc /\
    read RIP s=word(pc+64) /\ read RDI s=p /\ read RSI s=q /\
    read RDX s=word count /\ read memory s=m
    ==> crypto_observed_run (crypto_public_body7 pc p q count)
      (\s'. read RIP s'=(if count=1 then word(pc+86) else word(pc+64)) /\
            read RDI s'=word_add p (word 1) /\
            read RSI s'=word_add q (word 1) /\
            read RDX s'=word(count-1) /\ read memory s'=m /\
            bytes_loaded s' (word pc) crypto_memcmp_mc) s
CRYPTO_OBSERVATION_CALLABLE:
!pc stackpointer returnaddress p q n m (s:x86state).
    n<2 EXP 64 /\ bytes_loaded s (word pc) crypto_memcmp_mc /\
    read RIP s=word pc /\ read RSP s=stackpointer /\
    read (memory :> bytes64 stackpointer) s=returnaddress /\
    C_ARGUMENTS [p;q;word n] s /\ read memory s=m
    ==> crypto_observed_run (crypto_public_call pc p q n stackpointer returnaddress)
      (\s'. read RIP s'=returnaddress /\
            read RSP s'=word_add stackpointer (word 8) /\
            read memory s'=m /\ bytes_loaded s' (word pc) crypto_memcmp_mc) s
CRYPTO_OBSERVATION_CALL_LENGTH:
!pc (p:int64) q n stackpointer returnaddress.
    LENGTH(crypto_public_call pc p q n stackpointer returnaddress)=
      (if n=0 then 6 else if n=16 then 15 else 7*n+10)
CRYPTO_OBSERVATION_E2:
!pc stackpointer returnaddress p q n m rp xp ordinary (s:x86state).
    bp_e2_crypto_pre pc stackpointer returnaddress p q n m rp xp ordinary s
    ==> crypto_observed_run (crypto_public_call pc p q n stackpointer returnaddress)
          (\s'. read RIP s'=returnaddress /\
                read RSP s'=word_add stackpointer (word 8)) s
CRYPTO_OBSERVATION_EXECUTION_EXACT:
!trace P (s:x86state) other t.
    crypto_observed_run trace P s /\ LENGTH other=LENGTH trace /\
    crypto_observed_execution other s t
    ==> other=trace /\ P t
CRYPTO_OBSERVATION_EXECUTION_EXISTS:
!trace P s. crypto_observed_run trace P s ==>
    ?t. crypto_observed_execution trace s t /\ P t
CRYPTO_OBSERVATION_LOOP:
!n pc stackpointer returnaddress p q m (s:x86state).
    0<n /\ n<2 EXP 64 /\
    bytes_loaded s (word pc) crypto_memcmp_mc /\
    read RIP s=word(pc+64) /\ read RSP s=stackpointer /\
    read (memory :> bytes64 stackpointer) s=returnaddress /\
    read RDI s=p /\ read RSI s=q /\ read RDX s=word n /\ read memory s=m
    ==> crypto_observed_run (crypto_public_loop pc p q n stackpointer returnaddress)
      (\s'. read RIP s'=returnaddress /\
            read RSP s'=word_add stackpointer (word 8) /\
            read memory s'=m /\ bytes_loaded s' (word pc) crypto_memcmp_mc) s
CRYPTO_OBSERVATION_LOOP_LENGTH:
!n pc (p:int64) q stackpointer returnaddress.
    LENGTH(crypto_public_loop pc p q n stackpointer returnaddress)=7*n+3
CRYPTO_OBSERVATION_MONO:
!trace P Q (s:x86state).
    (!t. P t ==> Q t) /\ crypto_observed_run trace P s
    ==> crypto_observed_run trace Q s
CRYPTO_OBSERVATION_PROJECT:
!trace P (s:x86state).
    crypto_observed_run trace P s ==> eventually_n x86 (LENGTH trace) P s
CRYPTO_OBSERVATION_RELATIONAL:
!pc stackpointer returnaddress p q n m1 m2 rp xp ordinary (s1:x86state) s2.
    bp_e2_crypto_pre pc stackpointer returnaddress p q n m1 rp xp ordinary s1 /\
    bp_e2_crypto_pre pc stackpointer returnaddress p q n m2 rp xp ordinary s2
    ==> crypto_observed_run (crypto_public_call pc p q n stackpointer returnaddress)
          (\s'. read RIP s'=returnaddress /\
                read RSP s'=word_add stackpointer (word 8)) s1 /\
        crypto_observed_run (crypto_public_call pc p q n stackpointer returnaddress)
          (\s'. read RIP s'=returnaddress /\
                read RSP s'=word_add stackpointer (word 8)) s2
CRYPTO_OBSERVATION_UNIQUE:
!s obs1 obs2 (s':x86state).
    assurance_observed_step s obs1 s' /\ assurance_observed_step s obs2 s'
    ==> obs1=obs2
